about: That Old Chestnut entries per dartboard cell (key 'institution id|ring id'), 0.7.0, 7 Nov 2026. A cell gets an entry only on a real match: an old-chestnut entry whose evidence id (EV-…) is carried by a reply in that cell from the same institution; a tactic entry whose dated reply ('back_date') sits in that cell; a silence entry whose question's conversation (EV-…) has a reply in that cell. Entries with no such match get no 🌰. Links go to the entry's own anchor on bucklerfamily.estate/that-old-chestnut/.
